Question: Which of the following is closest to the product \((0.48017)(0.48017)(0.48017)?\)
Solution:
The choices are far apart, so bounds on the product are enough to determine the closest one. Let \(P=(0.48017)(0.48017)(0.48017)\). Since each positive factor is between \(0.48\) and \(0.5\),
\[
0.48^3<P<0.5^3,
\]
which gives
\[
0.110592<P<0.125.
\]
Thus \(P\) is above \(0.110\) and less than \(0.015\) away from it. Its distance from \(0.011\) is greater than \(0.110592-0.011=0.099592\). Each remaining choice is at least \(1.10\), so its distance from \(P\) is greater than \(1.10-0.125=0.975\).

Therefore the closest choice is \(\boxed{0.110}\), choice \(\mathrm{B}\).
